name: visual-layout-frame
goal: Only visual page frames appear under Layouts; the actual frame includes one working chat bubble and a clear child-content preview

evidence: The catalog counts framework bootstrap wrappers as layouts. Only ExplorerLayout draws the header and child-content frame. Existing chat is mounted beside it by the route root.

The normal explorer-category registry assertion never checked the real layout set. The component-catalog preview asserted only the child slot, so a frame without its route-hosted chat passed. Extend those existing matrices and the frame composition test.
